item.title: Am I the only one who hates delivery robots?
item.description:
📝 They may have seemed cute when they debuted, but delivery robots are clogging sidewalks, creeping through intersections and generally creating many more problems than they solve. Coco Robotics launched its next-generation, fully autonomous delivery robot, Coco 2. (Kayla Bartkowski / Los Angeles Times) Many people love Coco and other delivery robots, which partially replace traffic-clogging, exhaust-spewing delivery drivers with a more environmentally friendly alternative.
🔗 Read more: https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/story/2026-04-14/delivery-robots-creating-problems-glendale-ban

item.title: Waymo Drives Off with South Bay Man's Luggage
item.description:
📝 A Sunnyvale man says the Waymo that took him to the airport neglected to open the trunk for him to retrieve his luggage before driving off. Waymo said he could either pay for shipping or take two complementary rides to pick it up, which would take around two hours round trip from Sunnyvale. As SFist reported last fall, Waymo began offering service to San Jose airport in September.
🔗 Read more: https://sfist.com/2026/05/01/waymo-drives-off-with-south-bay-mans-luggage-after-trunk-fails-to-open/
